issues.description: Field display_start has inconsistent reserved size between artifacts: the template (template_repository/pixel.asm) reserves display_start with RESB 8294400 (corresponding to 1920×1080×4 bytes) as required by the problem statement (problem_statement.md says the screen resolution is 1920×1080). The solution (solution_repository/pixel.asm) instead reserves display_start with RESB 409600 (only 320×320×4 bytes) but still performs address calculations using a per-line byte multiplier for 1920 pixels (mov eax, 7680 / mul ebx). This mismatch (buffer size vs. address arithmetic) can lead to out-of-bounds accesses or confusion about the intended resolution and will mislead students when they implement or test set_pixel.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the buffer reservation and the address calculations consistent. Either (A) change the solution's display_start reservation to RESB 8294400 so it matches the problem statement and the 1920×1080 address arithmetic (recommended), or (B) if the solution intentionally uses a smaller test buffer, update the problem statement and the template to document the smaller resolution and adjust all per-line byte calculations (replace 7680 with width*4 for the chosen width) so all three artifacts agree.
